ProjAdjacentGeometry_0.0000

Difference
1590
Description

As AdjacentGeometry, but positions are unprojected through a D3D style perspective projection with z varying from the top to the bottom of each quad. Quads alternate in a checkerboard between the programmable pipeline (dark green, 0xFF009900) and the fixed function pipeline (light green, 0xFF00BB00), so seams between them show differences in how the two pipelines round projected vertices. This case uses no offset.

The render target is then drawn to the screen with the fixed function pipeline. Magenta shows texels the quad did not cover.
